Data.SecondaryAudience: Lead Engineers, Security Architect, QA Lead

ToneOptions.Label: Strategic & Authoritative
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Adopt a strategic and authoritative tone, emphasizing foresight and expert guidance.

ToneOptions.Label: Analytical & Persuasive
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Maintain an analytical and persuasive tone, building a strong case for multi-cloud adoption.

ToneOptions.Label: Visionary & Practical
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Strike a visionary yet practical tone, outlining future possibilities with actionable steps.

ToneOptions.Label: Technical & Comprehensive
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Employ a technical and comprehensive tone, detailing architectural considerations and implications.

GoalOptions.Label: Validate Strategic Intent
GoalOptions.Text: The primary goal is to inform and validate the strategic intent behind adopting a multi-cloud approach for AI/ML workloads. Success means stakeholders understand the imperative for change and the benefits of a secondary hyperscaler, aligning on the strategic direction.

GoalOptions.Label: Secure Approval
GoalOptions.Text: The main objective is to secure approval for the proposed multi-cloud strategy and the subsequent evaluation of AWS and GCP. Success is achieved when key decision-makers endorse the recommendation and allocate resources for the next phase.

GoalOptions.Label: Guide Technical Planning
GoalOptions.Text: This document aims to guide lead engineers and architects in the initial technical planning for multi-cloud integration. Success means they have a clear understanding of architectural principles, governance extensions, and pilot use case considerations.

GoalOptions.Label: Mitigate Risk
GoalOptions.Text: A key goal is to articulate how a multi-cloud strategy mitigates vendor concentration risk and enhances resilience for critical AI/ML operations. Success is measured by stakeholder confidence in the proposed approach's ability to improve business continuity and security posture.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Strategic Alignment & Business Value
Criteria: Clearly articulates the strategic necessity for multi-cloud in the context of AI/ML and data-intensive workloads.
Demonstrates a clear path to achieving differentiated capabilities and improved scalability.
Quantifies or qualitatively describes the business value and ROI of the proposed multi-cloud strategy.
Addresses vendor concentration risk and enhances organizational resilience.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical Feasibility & Architectural Soundness
Criteria: Provides a technically sound and feasible architectural approach for integrating a secondary hyperscaler.
Outlines a clear, phased roadmap with achievable milestones, particularly for AI/ML pilot use cases.
Details how existing Azure governance models will be extended and adapted for multi-cloud.
Identifies key technical challenges and proposes viable mitigation strategies.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Operational Impact & Resource Readiness
Criteria: Assesses the operational impact on existing teams and proposes necessary skill development or hiring.
Estimates the resource requirements (financial, human, tooling) for the multi-cloud transition.
Defines clear evaluation criteria for selecting the secondary hyperscaler (AWS vs. GCP).
Ensures the proposed strategy aligns with existing security and compliance frameworks.
